text: The bottom of the spiral. Almost every episode is harmful, and the god in the birdcage is watching.
Deep in the madness. Most episodes are harmful, but surviving them claws sanity back.
The tipping point. Good and bad episodes come in equal measure.
Mostly lucid. Most episodes are gifts, but every gift erodes a little more sanity.
Clear-eyed and beloved of the parrot god. Episodes are almost all gifts, and every one of them costs.
Even chance of both positive and negative events
[[b]]Sanity[[/b]] can only be gained through Commander Lu's presence and certain events.
[[b]]Sanity[[/b]] can only be lost through certain events.
Qu Pan's grip on reality, measured. Each Harvest, Sanity decides what kind of episode visits the court.
• Sanity triggers a seasonal event each Harvest, granting a random effect.
• Sanity events can be positive or negative and will increase or decrease Sanity.
• High Sanity increases the chance of positive events.
• Low Sanity increases the chance of negative and game-altering events.
• Put your trust in Commander Lu.
Qu Pan's grip on reality. High Sanity brings gifts that erode it; low Sanity brings disasters that restore it. Only Commander Lu stands outside the spiral.

Assign an officer to attend the Commander's perch and take down his counsel verbatim. The counsel is mostly squawks, but the officer returns strangely settled, and Qu Pan's grip on reality steadies. (+1 Sanity per turn)

[[b]]Sanity[[/b]]\\n[[col:scope_description]]Faction Feature[[/col]]\\nEach Harvest, Qu Pan's grip on reality decides what visits the court: gifts at high Sanity, disasters at low.\\nEvery gift erodes Sanity; enduring the disasters restores it.\\n[[i]][[col:flavour]]The spiral only turns one way, unless the bird says otherwise.[[/col]][[/i]]

[[b]]Commander Lu[[/b]]\\n[[col:scope_description]]Assignments[[/col]]\\nConsult Commander Lu: an assigned officer attends the perch and steadies Qu Pan's mind (+1 Sanity per turn).\\nWhen the hallucinations offer a choice, trusting the Commander is always the safer road.\\n[[i]][[col:flavour]]The counsel is mostly squawks. It works anyway.[[/col]][[/i]]

[[b]]The Birdcage Opens[[/b]]\\n[[col:scope_description]]Faction Feature[[/col]]\\nAt low Sanity the episodes stop being metaphors: armies are moved, wars are declared, courts are unmade.\\nOne episode, spoken only once, ends the campaign.\\n[[i]][[col:flavour]]I HAVE NO CRACKER AND I MUST SQUAWK.[[/col]][[/i]]
